title: DuoDiscover AI Beats Human Engineers on NVIDIA SOL-ExecBench

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A research group from Google Cloud, Stanford and Berkeley launched a new tool to automate the discovery and optimization of technical engineering systems. The system, called DuoDiscover, integrates the testing phase into its discovery process to solve the evaluation bottleneck where generating ideas takes seconds but testing takes days. It ranks #1 on NVIDIA's SOL-ExecBench and outperforms the best existing human and AI designed CPU prefetchers.

The system demonstrated 2x the performance of experts on SWE-fficiency and achieved gains of 2.68x over production TPU kernels. Additional results showed performance increases of 1.92x on vLLM and 1.44x on FreeToken, indicating a shift in the ability of AI agents to handle complex hardware and software optimization tasks.
